_location: Project-scoped configuration can live at <project-root>/.mcp.json. User-scope configuration is managed by the host CLI.
_cli: claude mcp add --transport http dreamer --scope project http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp

dreamer.description: Long-term user memory service with Awake semantic operations and optional Sleep-time consolidation.

tools.remember: Record a fact about the user (preferences/habits/cross-project lessons). NEVER call for project-specific facts.
tools.list_memory: Get an overview of core blocks + archival count.
tools.forget: Mark a fact as deleted (soft delete + audit log).
